comments: 26d54a0c: This program is used to set or edit parameters for the Incomplete Records Tracking (IRT) feature within the VistA system. It allows selection of a division to set parameters for IRT.
2fb2b4bc: Prompt the user to select a division from the Incomplete Records Tracking file.
c854066a: Once a division is selected, allow editing of IRT parameters for that division.
